callees.name: CodeGraphExtractor.from_proj_dir
callees.pre_condition: proj_dir is a path to a valid project directory.
callees.post_condition: Returns a CodeGraphExtractor instance initialized from the project directory, or None if initialization fails.

callees.name: CodeGraphExtractor.get_functions_by_file
callees.pre_condition: The CodeGraphExtractor instance is initialized. language is a recognized language key. proj_dir is the project directory path.
callees.post_condition: Returns a dictionary mapping each source file's absolute path (as a string) to a list of (function_name, function_body) tuples for all functions extracted from files in the given language under the project directory. Returns an empty dictionary if no functions are found.
